info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Delete Rideshare Rides Cancel-v4-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Cancellation API allows clients to cancel previously scheduled rides in the rideshare system. By sending a DELETE request to the designated endpoint, users can effectively remove their ride bookings and ensure that resources are freed up for other customers. This API is primarily used by rideshare applications and service providers looking to manage ride cancellations efficiently. The API facilitates seamless integration with mobile and web applications, enhancing user experience by providing direct control over ride bookings.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to cancel a scheduled ride. Make sure to provide the necessary ride details to successfully cancel it.

requestBody.description: Request body to initiate the cancellation of a ride. This payload should include the necessary information to identify the ride that is intended for cancellation.

201.description: The ride cancellation request was successfully processed and the ride has been canceled.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the DELETE operation to cancel a ride. It is in string format, typically used for simple identifiers or messages.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelResponse_201.title: Ride Cancellation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the cancellation request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: Current state of the ride after the cancellation attempt.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation request, in milliseconds.

message.description: Detailed message regarding the cancellation operation.

audit.description: Details about the audit trail for the cancellation operation.

DeleteRideshareRidesCancelResponse_201.description: Response schema for the ride cancellation operation, indicating the status and details of the operation.

AuditTrail.title: Audit Trail

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditTrail.description: Contains audit information about the operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server spent processing the request. A value of 0 indicates that processing was either instantaneous or negligible.
